name: childrens-book-platform
description: Photo-to-illustration children's book platform — personalization pipeline, cart/checkout, print dispatch.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB,HOMEPAGE -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web" "npm run homepage --prefix apps/api"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
